requirements.title: Data transfer processes list and namelist items in the specified order
requirements.definition: Data are transferred between the file and input/output list or namelist entities; ordinary list items are processed in input/output list order, namelist input items in input-record entity order, namelist output items in namelist-group-object-list order, and effective items are derived as described in 12.6.3.

pending.data-transferred-between-file-and-items: Use controlled READ and WRITE cases with initialized sentinels or '#' filled internal files to show values move between file and listed/namelist entities.
pending.ordinary-list-items-processed-in-list-or: Use a READ record with two distinct values into two sentinel variables and an output WRITE with side-effect-free distinct expressions; assert positions/values reflect list order.
pending.namelist-input-processed-in-input-record: Use a namelist input record assigning two variables in a deliberate order with repeated nondefault sentinels and assert only the final values required by the input record.
pending.namelist-output-processed-in-group-order: Use namelist output from a group declared in a known order and assert the order of variable names once 13.11 output spelling rules are registered.
pending.effective-items-derived-from-io-list-ite: Use an io-implied-do or array section with nondefault elements and assert the effective-item sequence after 12.6.3 registration.

requirements.title: Namelist input uses matching entities and the last repeated occurrence
requirements.definition: For namelist input, all values after a name= part in the input records are transmitted to the matching namelist entity before the succeeding input-record entity is processed, and the last occurrence of an entity in the input record supplies that entity's value or values.

pending.namelist-values-transmitted-to-matching-: Initialize namelist variables to distinct sentinels, read a namelist record with named assignments, and assert only the matching named variables change.
pending.namelist-entity-complete-before-succeedi: Use a namelist record with array-valued entity followed by another entity; assert the complete array value is established before observing effects tied to the succeeding entity where defined by 13.11.
pending.namelist-last-repeated-occurrence-wins: Read a namelist record assigning the same scalar two different nondefault values and assert the final value is the last occurrence.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.4-12.6.4.7, execution of a data transfer statement (batch162). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds. Round 1 found that the '*', INPUT_UNIT and OUTPUT_UNIT equality facets were planned through stdin/stdout capture and separate controls, which cannot observe unit identity; they are now recorded as having no portable oracle because 12.5.4 makes connecting one file to several units, and I/O through them, processor dependent, and neither NAME= nor NUMBER= rescues it. Source accounting only.
